parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Cytochrome P450 2C9. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name matching 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' and target_dictionary.organism matching 'Homo sapiens'. Require compound_structures joined as an INNER JOIN on molregno to ensure canonical SMILES are present. Sort results by compound ChEMBL identifier.
